mapper.sql: account.id, account.email, account.password_hash, account.company_id, account.terms_agreed_at, company.business_number AS company_business_number, company.company_name, company.business_status AS company_business_status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company ( business_number, company_name, business_status, verified_source, verified_at ) VALUES ( #{businessNumber}, #{companyName}, #{businessStatus}, #{verifiedSource}, #{verifiedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE company_name = #{companyName}, business_status = #{businessStatus}, verified_source = #{verifiedSource}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_number, company_name, business_status, verified_source, verified_at FROM company WHERE business_number = #{businessNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account ( email, password_hash, company_id, terms_agreed_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{companyId}, #{termsAgreedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM account INNER JOIN company ON company.id = account.company_id WHERE account.email = #{email}

SELECT
FROM account_session session INNER JOIN account ON account.id = session.account_id INNER JOIN company ON company.id = account.company_id WHERE session.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND session.expires_at > #{now}
